author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಎಲ್ಲ ತಿಳಿದಿದೆಯೆಂಬ ಹಮ್ಮು ಬಿಮ್ಮನು ಬಿಡಲು
ಬಲ್ಲಜನ ಸಂಗಸಿಹಿ ಲಭಿಸುವುದು ನಿನಗೆ
ಸಲ್ಲುತಿರು ಎಲ್ಲರೊಡೆ ಕ್ಷೀರಮಧು ಬೆರೆತಂತೆ
ಗೆಲ್ಲುತಿರು ಮನಗಳನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you drop the pride that says you know everything,
the sweet company of the wise will be yours;
belong with everyone, as milk blends with honey;
keep winning hearts, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Let go of the pride of thinking you know it all, and the wise will welcome you. Blend with people as milk blends with honey, and you will win their hearts.
